integrity: The exact proof reduces the published symmetric-plane formula to a one-variable expression and proves the global upper bound analytically. The bundled checker verifies algebraic identities and is corroborative, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The proof is for the real two-dimensional space \(\ell_3^2\) only; it does not claim the full \(p\)-dependence, higher dimensions, or complex scalars. Originality searches cannot exclude unindexed work under unrelated notation.
title: Exact isosceles-orthogonal constant of \(\ell_3^2\)
